title: Exactness of geometric stalks
statement:
For every geometric point $\bar t$ of $T$, the stalk functor $F\mapsto
F_{\bar t}$ of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]

$$
 \Ab(T_{\Et})\longrightarrow\Ab,\qquad F\longmapsto F_{\bar t}
$$

is exact (filtered colimits are exact and a stalk is a filtered colimit of
sections over pointed etale neighbourhoods).

mathlib_searches.query: fiber functor of a point of a site on sheaves preserves finite limits
stalk functor at a point of a site is exact on abelian sheaves

mathlib_match.how: one declaration per clause, with Φ = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pointSmallEtale s (s : Spec Ω ⟶ T, Ω separably closed; Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/EtalePoint.lean:64-65, a Point.{u} of smallEtaleTopology T, the stalk of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]) and A = AddCommGrpCat.{u}. Left exact: Point/Basic.lean:289-291, instance PreservesFiniteLimits Φ.sheafFiber under [LocallySmall.{u} C] (homs of Etale T lie in Type u), [HasFiniteLimits A] and [AB5OfSize.{u,u} A] = AB5 AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Algebra/Category/Grp/AB.lean:61-62). Right exact: Point/Skyscraper.lean:234-235, instance (Φ.sheafFiber (A := A)).IsLeftAdjoint (adjoint the skyscraper sheaf, :222-223; needs HasProducts.{u} and HasColimitsOfSize.{u,u}, both true for AddCommGrpCat.{u}), so it preserves all colimits of size u, in particular finite colimits, and zero morphisms (Limits/Preserves/Shapes/Zero.lean:73 preservesZeroMorphisms_of_isLeftAdjoint). Exactness in the sense of short exact sequences: Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/ShortExact.lean:107-112, ShortExact.map_of_exact takes these three instances and sends every short exact sequence 0→F→G→H→0 of sheaves to a short exact sequence of stalks.
